Contract: https://api.swaggerhub.com/apis/ip2whois/ip2whois-domain-lookup/1.0 (version 1.0; SHA-256 in manifest.json).

WHOIS example copied from https://www.ip2whois.com/developers-api (retrieved 2026-11-08). The documented JSON is serialized as text for the contract's text/html response media type. report.json validates the request and parses this provider-authored response; verdict.json includes the source audit. The API has one lookup operation and no writes. Connection evidence uses the documented locaproxy.com lookup, consumes quota and proves reachability only. No live key was used.
